mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS declines (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points from the prior month indicates weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in residential fixed investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) over the prior 3 months indicates a weakening housing market, which depresses consumer confidence and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as higher interest rates dampen corporate investment and consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising 3-month moving average of the unemployment rate signals increasing labor market slack, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods when UNRATE's 3-month moving average rises (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which reduces corporate profits and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising 3-month moving average of housing starts (HOUST) indicates expanding residential construction activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when HOUST's 3-month moving average rises (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 3.0% indicates accelerating inflation, which triggers expectations of monetary tightening and results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
